name: Prima Industries Limited
about: Prima Industries Limited manufactures and sells solvent extraction, edible oil refining, and cattle feed in India. It operates through Cattle Feed Division and Oil Cake Processing Division segments. The company offers coconut oil cakes and de oiled cakes; palm kernel, solvent, acid, rice bran oils, and various oil-bearing materials, as well as fatty acids and soap stocks; and cattle feed and feed pellets, and poultry feed line. It serves flour milling, solvent extraction and refining, and cattle feed manufacturing industries. Prima Industries Limited was founded in 1965 and is based in Cochin, India.
